label: August 10–16, 2026
intro: A big week: Mother's Day public holiday on Wednesday August 12 (blue lights at the Grand Palace, jasmine everywhere, fireworks), the NSM Brain Inside Out closes Tuesday, and then Character Fest Thailand 2 opens free at CentralWorld Friday through Sunday.

activities.title: Character Fest Thailand 2 — Opening Days
activities.time: CentralWorld mall hours; check event listings for show times
activities.location: CentralWorld, Level 1 — Beacon Zone, Central Court & Eden Zone (Chit Lom BTS)
activities.why: A vibrant pop culture festival bringing together beloved characters, artists, and fans for four days of interactive experiences, exclusive merchandise, and live entertainment. The 'Pop Star Party' theme means colorful, musical, high-energy fun — Thor will love the character meet-and-greets and interactive zones. Free entry makes it a no-brainer.
activities.tip: Arrive early on Saturday — first day of the weekend will be the most exciting. Weekday (Friday) visit is quieter if you can swing it. The festival continues into the following Sunday (Aug 17).

activities.title: Thai Mother's Day — Grand Palace & Blue Bangkok
activities.time: Morning ceremonies from 7am; evening blue illumination from sunset
activities.location: Grand Palace, Sanam Luang & Ratchadamnern Road, Bangkok
activities.price: Grand Palace entry ~500 THB adults; children under 120cm free
activities.why: Bangkok turns blue for Queen Sirikit's birthday — the Grand Palace, Democracy Monument, and CentralWorld are lit in blue, and children present jasmine garlands to their mothers. Sanam Luang fills with families and ceremonial processions. The evening fireworks display over the Chao Phraya is spectacular. A genuine once-a-year event.
activities.tip: Morning is cooler for the Grand Palace visit. Evening fireworks at Sanam Luang start after dark (~8pm). Long-tail boat across the river adds adventure. Make a jasmine bouquet with Thor beforehand.

activities.title: NSM Brain Inside Out — FINAL DAYS
activities.location: National Science Museum, Technopolis Khlong 5, Khlong Luang, Pathum Thani
activities.why: Last chance for the 'Brain Inside Out' special exhibition. If you haven't been, Tuesday–Wednesday is your final window before it closes. The main Science Museum and Natural History Museum remain open year-round, but this exhibition won't come back.
activities.tip: Tuesday August 11 is your best shot — quieter than the closing day rush on Wednesday. Public holiday Wednesday (Mother's Day) may mean it closes or changes hours — call ahead.

activities.title: ClassBento Kids Ceramic Workshop
activities.date: Book a weekend slot at classbento.co.th
activities.location: Multiple Bangkok studios (central BKK / Thonglor area)
activities.price: Check classbento.co.th for current session price
activities.why: Hands-on pinch pots, slabs, and coils for kids age 5+. Thor builds something from scratch and takes it home — classic building & making satisfaction. Good Saturday morning activity before Character Fest in the afternoon.
activities.tip: Book a few days ahead. Pair a morning ceramic session with an afternoon at Character Fest for a maximum-fun Saturday.

activities.title: Sub-Zero Ice Skating — Weekday Session
activities.date: Any weekday (note: call ahead for Mother's Day holiday hours)
activities.location: Sub-Zero Ice Skate Club, Major Cineplex Sukhumvit (Ekkamai BTS, skywalk access)
activities.price: 100 THB kids / 200 THB adults; skate rental included
activities.why: A quick weekday ice session before Character Fest takes over the weekend. August weekdays at Sub-Zero remain quiet and cheap — great window to keep Thor's ice skills sharp.
activities.tip: Wednesday is Mother's Day public holiday — rink may have different hours or be busier. Tuesday or Thursday is safer.

activities.title: Roller Dome Emporium — Weekend Session
activities.location: Roller Dome, Emporium Mall, Sukhumvit Soi 24 (Phrom Phong BTS)
activities.price: 150 THB/hr weekends; skates + protective gear included
activities.why: Keep Thor's rollerblading momentum going. Pair a morning Roller Dome session with Character Fest at CentralWorld in the afternoon — both are on the BTS Sukhumvit line, easy back-to-back.
activities.tip: Sunday 10–11am is quietest. Emporium to CentralWorld is 4 BTS stops (Phrom Phong → Chit Lom).
